note: Triennial election of the 20 electoral divisions of Banbridge rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Twenty-one nominations were lodged; the only contest was at Skeagh, and the other nineteen members were returned unopposed (returning officer's notice of result, Banbridge Chronicle, 14 June 1952, p. 6; round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Polled Thursday 5 June 1952. The Dromore Weekly Times describes Gibson as the official Unionist candidate; no label is printed in the notice.
